title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 408) reviews: Fresh minimum wage talks gather momentum

content.rendered:
Fresh discussions over Nigeria’s minimum wage have emerged after government officials and labour leaders signalled that the current ₦70,000 benchmark may no longer reflect the country’s rising cost of living.

The renewed debate has shifted beyond salary figures, with many Nigerians asking whether higher wages alone can improve living standards if inflation, transport fares, rent, and food prices continue to rise faster than workers’ incomes.

excerpt.rendered: Fresh talks on Nigeria’s minimum wage gather momentum as the current ₦70,000 benchmark fails to keep pace with rising inflation and living costs.
